objects.name: 23 Million User Records Compromised in Gyazo Data Breach
objects.description: Gyazo maker Helpfeel said the attacker exploited a vulnerability in its image upload server to gain unauthorized access. The post 23 Million User Records Compromised in Gyazo Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .
